---
title: "Classical Themes"
description: "2,067 themes from the classical repertoire: filter them as the Tune Assessment does, sort on up to three things, and show as many at a time as you like."
toc: false
---

<div id="ct-root">
  <p class="ct-hint">Themes from the classical repertoire, one or two phrases each: the openings of symphonies, sonatas, operas,
  songs and dances. Filter them the way the Tune Assessment's finder does (composer, tonality, meter, key, the note a theme starts on,
  a tonal pattern such as <em>Do Mi So</em>, rhythm patterns), then sort them on up to three things and show as many as you want.
  The scores don't say whether a key is major or minor, so a minor key is read from the work's title where it names the key, and
  otherwise guessed from the melody (marked "guessed"; right about four times in five).</p>
  <p class="ct-credit">The themes are the 2,067 of Barlow and Morgenstern's <em>A Dictionary of Musical Themes</em> (1948) newly
  engraved for the <a href="https://www.audiolabs-erlangen.de/resources/MIR/MTD">Musical Theme Dataset</a> (Zalkow, Balke,
  Arifi-Müller and Müller, International Audio Laboratories Erlangen, 2020), used under
  <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a> and converted to ABC.</p>
  <div id="ct-picker"></div>

      <div class="ct-line"><label><input type="checkbox" id="ct-yt"> Only themes with a recording</label>
        <button type="button" id="ct-reshuffle" title="New order for the Random sort">Reshuffle</button></div>
